carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple longitudinal ridges extending posteriorly along the dorsal surface, characterized by bright linear highlights on the superior edges and defined shadow gradients on the inferior edges.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Isolated, low-density high-luminance clusters primarily distributed near the posterior edge of the first dorsal fin silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent irregular notch and missing tissue on the posterior margin of the upper caudal lobe, indicating significant physical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Bright high-luminance tip on the apex of the first dorsal fin; multiple smaller high-contrast silhouettes localized around the ventral-caudal region.
